_language_note: This file illustrates the shape server.py's make_approved()/normalize_language() actually produce. 'approved-story-v1-en-only' shows what every v1 approval looks like today: source_language is always 'en', localizations is always {} — nothing here is auto-translated or pre-populated.
_headline_note: brief_headline is the canonical public headline field. headline is kept as a backward-compat alias with the same value. build.py reads brief_headline preferentially (falls back to headline). editorial_notes is never written to this file.
_archive_note: status:'archived' + archived_at route the record to archive.html only (excluded from homepage pool). The approved block is identical in structure to a normal approval — build.py always reads public content from approved regardless of status.
